page.layout: Two parallel columns of a Scripture index table, each with Cap. | Verf. | Pag. headings, separated by a central double rule; the left column runs from the top to the Epistle of James and the right column from I. Petri to Verf.2 at the foot. No page number, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.head: Locorum Scripturæ.
main_text.l: Cap. | Verf. | Pag. | Cap. | Verf. | Pag.

page.notes: The table is set in two columns; the cell pairing across the rule is reconstructed from the layout. Several numerals (e.g. 1114, 1100, 1063) are read from the scan. The first two lines of the right column read "I. PETRI." and "II. PETRI." as section headings; the line "I. JOH." is set between the I. Joh. rows. The line "II." at the bottom right is the start of a further entry, transcribed as printed. Faint stains and show-through are not transcribed.
